QF.id: VIII Introduction to Forwards and Futures_43

question.text: A trader goes long on 3 lots of Reliance futures at Rs. 2,850 per share. The lot size is 250. At expiry, Reliance spot closes at Rs. 2,780. What is the total profit or loss?

explanation.text: The Logic: Step-by-step calculation: 1. Position: Long 3 lots at Rs. 2,850 2. Settlement price: Rs. 2,780 3. Per share loss = 2,780 - 2,850 = -70 (loss because spot is below entry for a long position) 4. Per lot loss = -70 x 250 = -Rs. 17,500 5. Total loss for 3 lots = -17,500 x 3 = -Rs. 52,500 The Trap: Rs. 17,500 is the loss for one lot, not three. Rs. 70 is the per-share loss. Do not forget to multiply by number of lots and lot size. Note: Long futures P&L logic on pages 55 and 93 of the Series VIII workbook supports this calculation: (Settlement - Entry) x Lot Size x Number of Lots.
